info.description:
Better Metadata - Better Science

The worker server runs the background jobs the rest of CEDAR cannot do inside a request: work
that takes longer than a caller should wait, and that must survive being interrupted.

Its endpoints start a job and report on one. They are restricted to administrators.
info.title: CEDAR Worker Server API

post.description: Ask for the graph of which artifacts include which to be rebuilt, and return the job that will do it. The work is asynchronous, so this answers immediately with a job to poll rather than waiting for the rebuild. Only one job runs at a time: asking again while one is in flight returns that job rather than starting a second. Restricted to administrators.

Location.description: Where to poll this job's status.

403.description: The caller is not an administrator

409.description: A regeneration is already running; the job returned is that one, not a new one

Location.description: Where to poll the running job's status.

get.description: Report where a regeneration job has got to. Jobs are held in memory, so an identifier from before the last restart is no longer known. Restricted to administrators.

parameters.description: Job identifier, as returned when the job was started.
parameters.name: jobId

200.description: The job and its current state

403.description: The caller is not an administrator

404.description: No job answers to this identifier

get.summary: Get the status of a regeneration job
